mapper.select: select p.participant_id, p.consultation_id, p.user_id, p.user_type, p.join_time, p.leave_time, p.livekit_identity, p.status, p.create_time, u.nick_name as user_name from t_consultation_participant p left join sys_user u on p.user_id = u.user_id where p.participant_id = #{participantId}

select p.participant_id, p.consultation_id, p.user_id, p.user_type, p.join_time, p.leave_time, p.livekit_identity, p.status, p.create_time, u.nick_name as user_name from t_consultation_participant p left join sys_user u on p.user_id = u.user_id where p.consultation_id = #{consultationId} order by p.user_type, p.create_time

select p.participant_id, p.consultation_id, p.user_id, p.user_type, p.join_time, p.leave_time, p.livekit_identity, p.status, p.create_time from t_consultation_participant p where p.consultation_id = #{consultationId} and p.user_id = #{userId}
